Hi all —

Thanks — quick draft of the ML evaluation plan and checkpoints so everyone has clarity before the SDK session. Happy to iterate.

Eval checkpoints (minimum viable):
1) Latency profile (P50/P95/P99) on 1k, 10k, and 50k token windows using your baseline request mix. Target: P95 <= 250ms for single-token incremental requests; we’ll provide continuous-batching off/on comparisons.
2) Quality tests: run 200 curated prompts from your prior production set (we’ll coordinate a small prompt deck). Metrics: top-1 accuracy threshold + qualitative inspection of 20 edge cases.
3) Cost modeling: instrument token counts and live unit-cost; produce projected monthly cost at the 120 QPS baseline and at 300 QPS burst pattern.
4) Regression checks: compare Redwood model variant against your current service for NLL/ROUGE or your preferred metric.

Deliverables by end of Week 2:
- Latency report + traces (zip)
- Quality summary with examples and tuning suggestions
- Sizing recommendation for Dedicated (GPU type + estimated slots)

Planned timeline to support your December close target: if we get the sample and agree on a Friday SDK session this week, we can have the Week 2 deliverables ready by Fri 11/20, leaving two weeks for procurement and contract finalization.

Action items:
- Priya/Daniel: confirm SDK session time and send sample by Thu 11/12 EOD.
- Mina: I’ll draft the sizing note after the first benchmark run.
